_note: One first-run tip per tab (by tab id). Plain language; keep each under ~40 words.

sched.title: Build the day
sched.text: Each row is a store. Assign it to a person, reorder stops with the arrows, and watch hours and cost change. Press Run to start the clock.

merch.title: The merchandiser's phone
merch.text: This is what one person sees. The top card says what to do next. Tick 'Play this merchandiser' to work visits yourself, or practice any store without the clock.

super.title: Watch the day
super.text: Who's where, what's late and what's uncovered. Buttons under 'Needs coverage' show when each person would finish a stop. Alerts list everything that went wrong.

week.title: The week
week.text: Hours so far and projected for each day. End day rolls today in; New week starts Monday fresh.

rules.title: Switch the assumptions
rules.text: Pay rules, labor standards and goals are placeholders. Change one and every screen updates. Switch whole features off to see the day without them.

findings.title: Log what won't work
findings.text: Anything that wouldn't work in real life goes here, from any screen. These become requirements.

messages.title: Messages
messages.text: Messages tied to a stop between merchandisers, MSLs, schedulers and drivers. Replies are simulated.

promos.title: Promotions
promos.text: Promotions become display tasks at each matching store. Paste rows from a spreadsheet to try your own.

displays.title: Display compliance
displays.text: Every display from setup to removal and its result. Override a result after checking the photo.

store.title: Store page
store.text: Everything about one store, plus notes that stay with it for whoever works it next. Click any store name to come here.

photos.title: Photo review
photos.text: Suspected problems come first. Confirm or change the result; your call becomes the display's result.

scorecards.title: Scorecards
scorecards.text: Each person's day and week against draft goals. Change the goals under Pay & labor rules.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.text: Everything that went wrong this week, by type and day. Click a number to drill down to the stop.

timesheets.title: Timesheets
timesheets.text: Approve, return or adjust each person's day, then preview the payroll and mileage export. Nothing is sent.
